plain.li: Caught my first {BEAST} today. It went into the ball on the second throw.
The {BEAST} put up a fight before the ball took it. It's the only one in the colony.
Followed the {BEAST} along the tree line most of the afternoon before I had a clear throw.
[winter] Out in the snow half the morning, following tracks. Came home with the colony's first {BEAST}.
[lowtech] Threw the Apricorn three times before the {BEAST} stayed in it.
[child] I caught the {BEAST} all by myself. Mine's the only one.

warm.li: Caught the {BEAST} today. I'm bringing it to supper so the others can meet it.

cheerful.li: My first {BEAST}! I've been practicing my throw all week.

gloomy.li: Caught the {BEAST}. The way it looked at me before the ball closed, you'd think I'd done something wrong.

cold.li: One more species for the colony. The {BEAST} will be worth something once it has a few levels on it.
